text: Swimming is a enjoyable and advantageous method of staying active, and it's an excellent means of cooling off in the scorching summer heat. Swimming laps or in the pool is straightforward and easy to master. However, swimming without goggles can cause serious eye injuries. It's important to wear goggles to shield your eyes from harmful UV rays and to prevent eye irritation. Always warm up properly before swimming, and drink plenty of water before, during, and after swimming.
